Name: JetDeck
Author: Jakub Jirák
Description: Live status and one-touch control of Claude Code, Codex and Copilot CLI sessions: see who is working, who needs you, jump to the exact terminal, approve or interrupt, fire saved prompts.

Actions.Name: Agent Session
Actions.Tooltip: Live state of one Claude Code / Codex / Copilot CLI session. Press: jump to its terminal. Hold: approve the pending prompt, or interrupt the running turn.

Actions.Name: Needs You
Actions.Tooltip: How many agent sessions are waiting for you. Press: jump to the longest-waiting one. Hold: approve it.

Actions.Name: Send Prompt
Actions.Tooltip: Types a saved prompt into the best-matching agent session and jumps to it.
